name: release-plz
description: Update version and changelog based on semantic versioning and conventional commits

command.description: The release-plz command to run. Accepted values: `release-pr`, `release`. If unspecified, this action runs both these commands.

registry.description: Registry where the packages are stored. The registry name needs to be present in the Cargo config. If unspecified, crates.io is used.

config.description: Config file location. If not present, the first existing file among 'release-plz.toml', '.release-plz.toml', and '.config/release-plz.toml' is used, in that ord

forge.description: Git forge/backend. Valid values: 'github', 'gitea'. Defaults to 'github'.

backend.description: Supported for backward compatibility. Use 'forge' instead.

manifest_path.description: Path to the Cargo.toml of the project you want to update. If not provided, release-plz will use the Cargo.toml of the root directory. Both Cargo workspaces and

token.description: Token used to publish to the cargo registry

verbose.description: Print module and source location in logs.
